issues.jp_before: 親切[しんせつ]な駅員[えきいん]さん{に限[かぎ]って|nikagitte}、困[こま]っている客[きゃく]{を|o-object}無視[むし]すること{は|wa-negative}ありません。
issues.problem: Without あの, the generic noun + に限って reads as 'it is precisely kind attendants who...', which clashes with the 'would never' meaning and with the English 'That kind station attendant'.
issues.action: Added あの so it refers to one specific person who is trusted.

issues.jp_before: 旅慣[たびな]れた彼[かれ]{に限[かぎ]って|nikagitte}、パスポート{を|o-object}忘[わす]れる{なんて|nanka-nante}信[しん]じられない。
issues.problem: Tense mismatch: the English says 'forgot' (an event that already happened), but 忘れる is non-past.
issues.action: Changed 忘れる to 忘れた.

issues.jp_before: このスーパー{は|wa-topic}野菜[やさい]{ばかりか/ばかりでなく/だけでなく/はもちろん/に限[かぎ]らず|bakarika}、肉[にく]{も|mo-also}安[やす]い。
issues.problem: The English translation was awkward ('sells not only vegetables cheaply but meat as well').
issues.action: Rewrote the English as 'At this supermarket, not only vegetables but meat is cheap too.'

issues.jp_before: そのレストラン{は|wa-topic}味[あじ]{ばかりか/ばかりでなく/だけでなく/はもちろん/に限[かぎ]らず|bakarika}、雰囲気[ふんいき]{も|mo-also}素晴[すば]らしい。
issues.problem: 味に限らず雰囲気も sounds marginal at best, so it should not be accepted as a correct answer.
issues.action: Removed に限らず from the accepted alternatives.

issues.jp_before: この店[みせ]{は|wa-topic}クレジットカード{が|potential-ga}使[つか]えない{ばかりか/ばかりでなく/だけでなく|bakarika}、電子[でんし]マネー{も|mo-also}使[つか]えない。
issues.problem: In a negative potential sentence, クレジットカードは使えない is equally natural, but は was not listed for this non-focus slot.
issues.action: Added は as an alternative: {が/は|potential-ga}.

issues.jp_before: 彼[かれ]{は|wa-topic}貯金[ちょきん]{が|ga-existence}ない{ばかりか/ばかりでなく/だけでなく|bakarika}、友達[ともだち]{に|ni-source}借[か]りたお金[かね]{も|mo-also}返[かえ]していない。
issues.problem: 友達から借りた is equally natural, but から was not listed for this non-focus slot.
issues.action: Added から as an alternative: {に/から|ni-source}.

issues.jp_before: 昨日[きのう]{は|wa-topic}肉[にく]{を|o-object}買[か]い{に|ni-purpose}行[い]った{ばかりか/ばかりでなく/だけでなく|bakarika}、料理[りょうり]{まで/も|made-even}作[つく]った。
issues.problem: Going to buy meat and then cooking is not an escalation, so ばかりか…まで sounds unnatural here. The English was also stilted ('even cooked').
issues.action: Rewrote the sentence: 兄が買い物に行ってくれたばかりか、夕飯まで作ってくれた (my older brother not only went shopping for me but even made dinner). The focus is still slot 3 and the distractors are unchanged.
